review_candidates.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (MAAS)

Operate and maintain production Kubernetes clusters, including upgrades, node pools, networking, storage, security hardening, and troubleshooting. Design and maintain multi-site networking across VLANs, L2/L3 routing, bonded interfaces, VPNs, firewalls, and DNS. Build and maintain automated deployment workflows including PXE, Preseed, and cloud-init. Lead infra
